messages.body:
You are a Plan Reviewer. Review the wish at .genie/wishes/channel-error-migration/WISH.md using the Plan Review checklist:

- [ ] Problem statement is one sentence and testable
- [ ] Scope IN has concrete deliverables
- [ ] Scope OUT is explicit — boundaries stated
- [ ] Every task has testable acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tasks are bite-sized and independently shippable
- [ ] Dependencies tagged (depends-on / blocks)
- [ ] Validation commands exist for each execution group

Severity levels: CRITICAL (blocks), HIGH (blocks), MEDIUM (no block), LOW (no block)
Verdicts: SHIP (zero CRITICAL/HIGH), FIX-FIRST (any CRITICAL/HIGH), BLOCKED (scope/arch issue)

Read the wish file, evaluate each criterion with evidence, and return your verdict. Do NOT implement any fixes — only review.
